Nicole Park: Hey all  Nicole here, first day on Eng Platform (remote, EST). Quick Qs: who do I DM for VPN/SSH and MDM enrollment? Also where do I pick sticker designs, and any recs for lunch near the SF office when I visit? Small fun fact: I draw comics on weekends.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Nicole!! :tada: Buddy = Sam W. I'll DM your onboarding schedule. Swag/stickers: https://redwood.company/swag-form. Any food allergies?

Sam Wells: Hey Nicole  welcome! I'll DM and set up a 20-min intro. For SSH: generate an ed25519 key and paste the pub key into the IT portal (https://it.redwood/portal). For VPN we'll send a WireGuard profile after MDM.

Raj (Eng Infra): Quick commands: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"nicole@redwood.com\"` then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste into the portal. If you want, DM me the pub key and I'll queue the ACL adds once IT finishes the ticket.

IT-Bot: IT ticket #IT-9997 opened: "Onboard Nicole Park - VPN/SSH/MDM". Assigned to eng-ops. ETA: 1 business day.

Asha (DevEx): For dev environment we have a devcontainer in `git@github.com:redwood/dev-environments`. If you prefer local, ping me and I'll share minimal dotfiles.

Zoe (HR): Welcome! We'll send a welcome box to the address on file. If you'd like extra sticker designs, add them on the swag form. Also we run a monthly comic/book swap in SF  you'll fit right in :)

Nicole Park: Thanks everyone! No allergies. I'll submit the portal ticket and DM Sam. Excited to meet folks and bring some comics for the swap when I'm in SF. :sparkles:
